name: Composition

Dutch Angle.prompt: The camera held at a slight dutch tilt, diagonal frame energy, subtle visual instability, and stylized dynamic tension

Low Angle Hero.prompt: The camera placed well below eye level looking upward, subject appears taller and more imposing, chin slightly lifted, dramatic upward perspective

Over Shoulder.prompt: The  camera positioned just behind the shoulder line, partial shoulder framing in the foreground, intimate observational viewpoint, and layered spatial depth

Side Profile.prompt: camera aligned to a clean side profile view, strong facial contour readability, clear silhouette line, and elegant lateral composition

Straight On.prompt: camera placed directly in front of the subject at eye level, frontal alignment, direct visual engagement, and balanced symmetrical read

Three Quarter View.prompt: camera positioned slightly off axis around a three quarter angle, partial turn toward the lens, dimensional facial planes, and natural portrait depth

Top Down.prompt: camera placed directly above the subject looking straight down, flattened perspective, graphic shape emphasis, and strong spatial pattern readability

Deep Focus.prompt: narrow aperture near f11, sharp focus from face through background, visible background texture detail, deep depth of field with crisp edges throughout

Long Exposure.prompt: long exposure portrait with the subject frozen by controlled flash while the background shows horizontal motion streaks from passing ambient lights

Shallow DOF.prompt: very wide aperture near f1.4, razor thin focus plane on the eyes, extreme background blur, strong subject isolation, soft creamy out of focus backdrop

Medium Shot.prompt: medium shot framing from waist or chest level, balanced context plus expression visibility, versatile editorial storytelling composition

Tight Close Up.prompt: tight close up crop prioritizing face detail and emotional micro expressions, reduced background distraction, intimate visual proximity

Wide Shot.prompt: wide shot composition showing full body and meaningful environment context, spatial storytelling emphasis, clear scene geography

Centered.prompt: center weighted composition with symmetrical balance, strong subject authority, direct visual emphasis, stable formal framing language

Diagonal Energy.prompt: diagonal compositional flow using tilted lines or posture vectors, dynamic tension, kinetic visual momentum

Foreground Layer.prompt: foreground element layering to add depth and parallax, partial frame overlap, enhanced cinematic dimensionality

Leading Lines.prompt: composition guided by converging leading lines toward subject, depth reinforcement, viewer eye path control, narrative directionality

Negative Space.prompt: expanded negative space around subject for minimalist emphasis, clean readability, strong figure to ground separation

Rule of Thirds.prompt: rule of thirds subject placement with intentional negative space, directional gaze room, visually dynamic but balanced image structure

Symmetrical.prompt: strict symmetrical framing with mirrored architectural or environmental lines, central axis precision, highly ordered visual rhythm

base_prompt: young caucasian woman, with a white blouse, in a professional fashion photo shoot, clean natural pose, relaxed confident expression, looking toward camera, studio-quality image,  simple background
